mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM order_evidence_record WHERE rental_order_id=#{orderId} AND evidence_node='outbound' AND evidence_type='photo' AND uploaded_role='factory' AND draft_removed_at IS NULL AND file_storage_key IS NOT NULL AND upload_receipt_id IS NOT NULL

SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM rental_order_item i LEFT JOIN order_outbound_item_check c ON c.rental_order_id=i.rental_order_id AND c.rental_order_item_id=i.id WHERE i.rental_order_id=#{orderId} AND (c.id IS NULL OR c.expected_quantity<>i.quantity OR c.checked_quantity<>i.quantity OR (i.asset_type_snapshot='A_ASSET' AND i.quantity<>(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM order_outbound_scan_record s WHERE s.outbound_record_id=c.outbound_record_id AND s.rental_order_item_id=i.id))))
mapper.update: UPDATE order_outbound_record SET outbound_status='completed',outbound_photo_count=#{photos},operator_user_id=#{actor}, outbound_at=#{at},dispatch_at=#{at},updated_at=#{at},version=version+1 WHERE id=#{id} AND version=#{version} AND outbound_status='pending'
UPDATE rental_order SET order_status=#{after},version=version+1,updated_at=#{at} WHERE id=#{orderId} AND order_status=#{before}
UPDATE order_transport_leg SET leg_status='dispatched',dispatched_at=#{at},updated_at=#{at},version=version+1 WHERE id=#{id} AND rental_order_id=#{orderId} AND leg_status='ready'
UPDATE order_transport_leg SET leg_status='completed',completed_at=#{at},updated_at=#{at},version=version+1 WHERE id=#{id} AND rental_order_id=#{orderId} AND leg_status='dispatched'
UPDATE order_receipt_check SET check_status=#{status},confirmed_at=#{at},updated_at=#{at},version=version+1 WHERE id=#{id} AND version=#{version} AND check_status='pending'
UPDATE rental_order_delivery SET delivery_status='received_confirmed',updated_at=#{at} WHERE rental_order_id=#{orderId} AND delivery_status IN ('dispatched','receipt_checking')
mapper.select: SELECT rental_order_id FROM order_receipt_check WHERE check_status='pending' AND deadline_at<=#{at} AND rental_order_id>#{afterId} ORDER BY rental_order_id LIMIT 100
SELECT id FROM order_fulfillment_event WHERE rental_order_id=#{orderId} AND event_idempotency_key=#{key}

SELECT id,rental_order_id,event_type,event_time,operator_role,source_type,source_id,event_payload_json->>'$.summary' summary FROM order_fulfillment_event WHERE rental_order_id=#{orderId} ORDER BY event_time DESC,id DESC LIMIT #{query.pageSize} OFFSET #{query.offset}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM order_fulfillment_event WHERE rental_order_id=#{orderId}
